title.narrative: U.S. Peace Corps Overseas Program Support

description.narrative: Overseas program support costs in Ghana. Includes overseas staff salaries and benefit costs, leases, staff travel, communications, conferences, supplies, equipment and International Cooperative Administrative Support Services (ICASS). Excludes costs for training, medical and security.
